title: Export & import
intro: Move a whole site between NodePress installs in one JSON file: content, users, roles, media records, settings, plugins, form submissions and history.
mediaNote: Media files aren't in the file: copy the uploads folder to the new server by hand. Image links change to the new site's address when you import.
exportText: Download the whole site as one JSON file. It never holds passwords, API keys, webhook secrets or form webhook headers. It does hold user emails and form submissions, so keep it private.
importText: Choose a site export. Everything is matched by name, slug or email, and relations between entries keep working. People already on this site keep their login and role.
invalidFile: This isn't a NodePress site export
overwriteHint: Off: anything that already exists here is kept as it is, and only new items are added.
cliHint: For large sites, use the CLI: npx nodepress site:export and npx nodepress site:import.
